data: Microsoft reported revenue of $281.7 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, up 15% from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024 (an increase of about $36.6 billion). Net income was $101.8 billion, up 16% from $88.1 billion the year before. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's FY2025 results rather than a live lookup, so please confirm them against the company's Form 10-K or its investor relations release before relying on them.
